facts.heading: Marriage ended after fifteen years
facts.content: Jana and her husband Radko decided on a divorce after fifteen years of marriage.
facts.evidence: After fifteen years of marriage, my husband Radko and I decided on a divorce

facts.heading: Divorce conversation in September
facts.content: Radko told Jana in September that the marriage couldn't go on like this.
facts.evidence: in September he told me that it couldn't go on like this

facts.heading: Jana's emotional reaction to news
facts.content: Jana experienced feelings of emptiness and anger several times a day after the news.
facts.evidence: Emptiness, then anger, then emptiness again. It happens several times a day.

facts.heading: Radko's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radko stated that the couple drifted apart and lived next to each other.
facts.evidence: He says that we drifted apart, that we live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana's self-blame regarding marriage
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the signs of the drifting apart in the marriage.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind.

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about her feelings
facts.content: Jana wonders if she was too tired or if she cared too much for Radko.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired, I didn't care about him.

facts.heading: Struggling due to children
facts.content: Jana is struggling mainly because of the children.
facts.evidence: Yes, mainly because of the children.

facts.heading: Children's names and ages
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anička who is 12 and Matěj who is 8.
facts.evidence: I have two children, Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8

facts.heading: Decision to tell children about divorce
facts.content: Jana and Radko have not told the children about the divorce yet.
facts.evidence: No. Radek wants us to tell them together, or we postpone it.

facts.heading: Anička's suspicion of fighting
facts.content: Anička asked Jana if her father and Jana were fighting last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if Dad and I are fighting.

facts.heading: Jana's feeling after lying to Anička
facts.content: Jana felt terrible after lying to Anička about the fighting.
facts.evidence: I felt terrible.

facts.heading: Jana's fear regarding telling children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of her children's tears when the truth is revealed.
facts.evidence: but I am afraid of her tears.

facts.heading: Housing arrangements after divorce
facts.content: The house is on a mortgage, and Radko will probably move in with his brother.
facts.evidence: The house is on a mortgage, Radek is probably moving in with his brother, at least for now.

facts.heading: Child's living situation
facts.content: The child will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: The child will stay with me.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of managing alone
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will not manage the situation alone, as Radko usually handled money.
facts.evidence: I am afraid I won't manage it alone.

facts.heading: Jana's employment details
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Principal knows about distress
facts.content: Jana told the principal about her distress.
facts.evidence: Only the principal. I told her

facts.heading: Principal allowed early leave
facts.content: The principal allowed Jana to leave class early when she cried in the hallway.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave early

facts.heading: Jana feels worse when alone
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was at home alone.
facts.evidence: But then I sat at home and it was worse

facts.heading: Jana has work structure
facts.content: Jana has something to do at work.
facts.evidence: I had at least something to do at work

facts.heading: Wakes at 3 AM thinking
facts.content: Jana wakes up every night at three in the morning thinking about the future.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at three in the morning and think about what will happen next

facts.heading: Worries about finances and children
facts.content: Jana worries about not having a mortgage, not having a husband, and how to tell the children about finances.
facts.evidence: That I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything. Then I calculate the money, then I imagine how I will tell the children

facts.heading: Sleep pattern details
facts.content: Jana falls asleep around five and wakes up at half past seven.
facts.evidence: I fall asleep around five and wake up at half past seven

facts.heading: Weight loss and appearance
facts.content: Jana has lost four kilos and her friend told her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I've lost four kilos. My friend tells me I look terrible

facts.heading: Support system includes sister and friend
facts.content: Jana has her sister Alana in Olomouc who calls her almost every evening, and a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have my sister Alana in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening. And my friend Eva from work

facts.heading: Jana minimizes issues to Eva
facts.content: Jana tells Eva that she is having a difficult period but does not want Eva to think anything about her.
facts.evidence: To Eva just that I'm having a difficult period. I don't want her to think anything about me

facts.heading: Fear of being judged by Eva
facts.content: Jana fears Eva might think that a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children

facts.heading: Belief about marriage from mother
facts.content: Jana believes that marriage is held together by the children, a belief she attributes to her mother.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mom. She always said that marriage is held together by the children

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to Jana
facts.content: Jana's mother was silent after Jana told her about her situation, and then said she hoped Jana thought about it well.
facts.evidence: She was silent. Then she said that she hopes I thought about it well

facts.heading: Jana desires mother's approval
facts.content: Jana would need her mother to approve of her.
facts.evidence: I would need her to approve of me

facts.heading: Struggle to express needs
facts.content: Jana finds it difficult to express that she doesn't want to be alone in her family.
facts.evidence: That it hurts that I don't want to be alone, but that's not done in our family

facts.heading: Crying when expressing feelings
facts.content: When Jana says her feelings out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry and apologize

facts.heading: Finding relief in talking
facts.content: Jana finds that saying things out loud in the session helps her a little.
facts.evidence: it helps a little

facts.heading: Goals for sleep and children
facts.content: Jana's current goals are sleeping better and knowing how to tell her children.
facts.evidence: Sleeping and knowing how to tell the children

facts.heading: Current sleep aid use
facts.content: Jana uses chamomile tea to aid sleep and does not want pills.
facts.evidence: Chamomile tea and that's it. The doctor didn't offer me pills, but I don't want them

facts.heading: Fear of waking for children
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up in time for the children.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up in time for the children

facts.heading: Fear of addiction
facts.content: Jana does not want to become addicted.
facts.evidence: I don't want to be addicted

facts.heading: Fear of crying with panic
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will cry with panic if she cannot stay calm.
facts.evidence: That I'll cry with panic that I won't be able to stay calm

facts.heading: Fear of crying in front of children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of crying in front of the children because it would be scary for them.
facts.evidence: That I would cry in front of the children? After all, it would be scary for them

facts.heading: Anička is sensitive
facts.content: Jana believes Anička is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Anička is sensitive

facts.heading: Test today's focus
facts.content: Jana's focus today is on not feeling alone and not having to manage things right away.
facts.evidence: That I am not alone and that I don't have to manage it right away
